title: The European Convention protects freedom of expression, including the freedom to hold opinions and to receive and impart information
summary: The European Convention protects freedom of expression, including the freedom to hold opinions and to receive and impart information.
body: Article 10 says everyone has the right to freedom of expression, including freedom to hold opinions and to receive and impart information and ideas without interference by public authority and regardless of frontiers. The source says: "Everyone has the right to freedom of expression." The article continues with duties and responsibilities and with conditions under which the exercise may be subject to formalities, conditions, restrictions, or penalties. Those conditions are part of the article.
